about: What the kernel of Linux answers in another way than the one of macOS. For the tests that run bun's code for macOS on Linux (test.ts, test-run-on-mac.ts): a step that goes through shared code and the C library of the image is answered by the kernel of the machine, so there the line of Linux stands in the place of the line that is expected of a Mac.

lines.why: unlink(2) of a directory: EPERM on macOS, EISDIR on Linux
